From sulfur in fuels; causes acid rain
Solid soot; global dimming and lung damage
Total greenhouse gases over a life cycle

walkthroughs.body_html:
Complete: CH4 + 2O2 -> CO2 + 2H2O.

Incomplete (limited O2): 2CH4 + 3O2 -> 2CO + 4H2O.

Carbon monoxide binds to haemoglobin and stops O2 transport.

SO2 and NOx -> acid rain: kills aquatic life, weathers buildings.

Particulates cause global dimming and respiratory problems.

NOx forms in hot car engines when N2 reacts with O2.

Use renewable energy, reduce travel, eat less meat.

Carbon capture stores CO2 underground or in oceans.

Governments use carbon taxes and emissions targets.
